import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get coordinates of Central station (station_id = 16) and all other stations
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as longitude, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as latitude
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id
""")
stations = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(stations)

# Central station coordinates
central_lat = 22.281814
central_lon = 114.158127

# Classify all other stations into quadrants
ne_count = 0
nw_count = 0
se_count = 0
sw_count = 0

for _, row in stations.iterrows():
    if row['id'] == 16:  # Skip Central itself
        continue
    lat_diff = row['latitude'] - central_lat
    lon_diff = row['longitude'] - central_lon
    
    if lat_diff >= 0 and lon_diff >= 0:
        ne_count += 1
        quadrant = "NE"
    elif lat_diff >= 0 and lon_diff < 0:
        nw_count += 1
        quadrant = "NW"
    elif lat_diff < 0 and lon_diff >= 0:
        se_count += 1
        quadrant = "SE"
    else:
        sw_count += 1
        quadrant = "SW"
    
    print(f"{row['name_en']:20s} (lat={row['latitude']:.4f}, lon={row['longitude']:.4f}) -> {quadrant}")

print(f"\nNE: {ne_count}, NW: {nw_count}, SE: {se_count}, SW: {sw_count}")
